entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-13
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • SQL Server: a parameterized collection used several times in one query falls back to OPENJSON well below the parameter limit (11.0 regression) #39631
  • A single non-foldable grouped aggregate forces all sibling navigation aggregates in the same projection into correlated subqueries #39628
    Backlog

Closed

  • Any method named `Compare` is translated as the natural comparison of its arguments, so a comparer's own ordering is silently ignored (`StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase`, custom `IComparer<T>`) #39402
    12.0-preview1
  • AutoInclude not working with unidirectional many-to-many #31380
    12.0-preview1
  • Query: invalid SQL generated when doing join with nested anonymous key selectors #35028
    12.0-preview1
  • Querying a table-splitting dependent of a derived TPH type returns rows of other types #39458
    12.0-preview1
  • Improve remaining JsonReaderInvalidTokenType exceptions during JSON materialization #39486
    12.0-preview1
  • Apostrophe symbol in SQL Server column description is scaffolded as ' #34714
    12.0-preview1
  • Allow changing CLR type in query translation without additional SQL #33733
    12.0-preview1
  • Backport query-precompiler fixes (method parameters, captured members, ExecuteUpdate setter order) to 10.0.x #39539
  • Query precompiler folds conditionals on captured variables using fake defaults and drops a SQL branch #39428
    12.0-preview1
  • Allow configuration of JSON serialization for a given property in the model #28835
    8.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • Lift GroupBy aggregates over navigations next to operator chains #39648
    community-contribution
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39645
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0' => 'main' #39642
  • Support && and || null checks in conditional projection member access #39636
    community-contribution
  • Count a reused parameterized collection once when checking the SQL Server parameter limit #39634
    community-contribution
  • Scaffold foreign keys whose column type differs from the principal key #39633
    community-contribution
  • Bump hono from 4.13.13 to 4.13.16 in /eng/harness-evaluation #39632
    area-infrastructure
  • Support null versus empty for owned JSON collections #39630
    community-contribution
  • [release/11.0] Preserve generated values when replacing entries #39629
  • Bump @hono/node-server from 2.1.5 to 2.1.6 in /eng/harness-evaluation #39627
    area-infrastructure

Merged

  • Disable automation for release/8.0 and release/9.0 #39644
  • Report the resolved path when writing scripts and document the base for --output #39566
    community-contribution
  • Only translate static Compare methods declared on the operand type #39491
    community-contribution
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0' => 'release/10.0' #39643
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0' => 'release/9.0' #39558
  • [release/11.0]: Bump FSharp.Core from 11.0.101 to 11.0.102 #39637
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0]: Bump Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore from 9.0.22 to 9.0.23 #39638
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0]: Bump Microsoft.Azure.Cosmos from 3.63.4 to 3.64.0 #39639
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0]: Bump Microsoft.Data.SqlClient from 7.1.1 to 7.1.2 #39640
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0]: Bump Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.Extensions.Azure from 7.1.1 to 7.1.2 #39641
    area-infrastructure
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0' => 'release/10.0' #39559
  • Keep navigation configuration when a navigation becomes a skip navigation #39502
    community-contribution
  • Flatten nested anonymous types in join key selectors #39514
    community-contribution
  • Filter required table-splitting dependents of a derived TPH type by its discriminator #39528
    community-contribution
  • Fix Helix test failures #39635
  • [release/11.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39624
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0' => 'main' #39516
  • Improve remaining JsonReaderInvalidTokenType exceptions during JSON materialization #39517
    community-contribution, api-review
  • Don't escape quotes and apostrophes in scaffolded XML comments #39536
    community-contribution
  • Allow changing CLR type without SQL conversion #39397
    community-contribution, api-review
  • Make non-shared query test store names unique per test class #39551
    community-contribution
  • Preserve captured-dependent branches during query precompilation #39479
    area-harness

Updated

  • Place the model snapshot in --output-dir when it is specified #39565
    community-contribution
  • Don't leave the context in a bad state when tracking an entity fails #39614
    community-contribution, area-harness
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'release/11.0' #39543
  • Make JSON complex types nullable over a LEFT JOIN #39524
    community-contribution
  • Resolve grouping aggregates to the query SQL evaluates them in #39451
    community-contribution
  • Translate `Array.Exists` to `Queryable.Any` #39535
    community-contribution
  • Simplify adding and dropping CHECK constraints for SQLite migrations #39488
    community-contribution
  • Don't scaffold a foreign key as one-to-one when its unique index is filtered #39574
    community-contribution
  • Translate primitive collections projected through set operations #39561
    community-contribution
  • Make service provider context discovery best-effort in the tools #39562
    community-contribution
  • Add model-wide and member JSON reader/writer configuration #39483
    api-review, area-harness
  • Prune skip navigation includes in ExecuteUpdate/ExecuteDelete #39515
    community-contribution
  • Fix scalar ExecuteUpdate setter query precompilation #39307
  • Preserve independent Skip/Take parameters in precompiled queries #39478
    area-harness
  • Preserve implicit conversions during query precompilation #39313
    area-harness
  • Support required-member DTO initializers in query precompilation #39311
    area-harness
  • Translate DbContext members to the context constant during query precompilation #39557
    community-contribution
  • Add NOT NULL for persisted computed column if the column is not nullable #39417
    community-contribution
  • Don't rewrite Any/All to Contains when the item references the lambda parameter #39433
    community-contribution
  • Fix misleading exception messages when obtaining DbSet with entity type name (#31565) #39342
    community-contribution
  • Fix collection Contains normalization element type and overload matching (#39329) #39359
    community-contribution
